title: Q-CIFAIL-mergeaudit-1851: PR #1851 merged without a green checks run
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation mergeaudit --probe 1851
**Status:** closed

MERGE-AUDIT-1: PR #1851 (Raise hard error in GH helper on bad status to prevent silent failures and stuck loops (#Q-RECUR-5f8b2445f4)) merged at 2026-11-21T20:30:56Z with its `checks` run at `failure` on head d5756f1. Some merge path skipped the green gate.

Fix what that run caught on main (run the failed step from .github/workflows/checks.yml locally), then confirm a later merged PR passed `checks`. Do not weaken a check.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T21:41:03Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T01:12:55Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T15:31:21Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: green since
